commit_limitation: Evaluation-only protocol is timestamped and hash-pinned before native launch; uncommitted worktree, not a Git preregistration commit.
purpose: Validate a durable exact-record selective-context reference and deterministic evidence gate against the rejected v1 learned candidate without another training run.
hypothesis: Fact-level ledger admission, supersession and exact retrieval should match full-context answers while gate-off paths preserve the disabled base. This diagnoses reference/readout separately from learned fast-memory quality.
parent_role: M3 ownership reference with failed retention; not an accepted general-memory baseline.
candidate_role: Rejected 24-update v1 candidate used only for diagnosis; never selected as default or promoted.

dataset.scope: Exposed v1 regression material only; no training or checkpoint selection.

exact_reference.record_granularity: One immutable fact line per record; correction supersedes only its changed fact.
exact_reference.state_ownership: RecordLedger is authoritative; fast tensors are derived, source-view-bound images.
exact_reference.recovery: Atomic image publication, transaction-fault rollback, stale-view rejection and permitted-source rebuild; not a power-loss or neural-unlearning claim.

evidence_gate.rule: Eligible structured fact must cover query content and an entity-like term. Conflict, absent evidence and unstructured lookalike text disable fast memory.
evidence_gate.disabled_behavior: Exact frozen-base inference with no fast branch.

evaluation.adversarial_observation: The launch code for project Alder is teal.
evaluation.metadata_invariance: Changing split, role, kind or expected answer metadata must not change route or generated tokens.
evaluation.reference_decision: Exact selective context must be correct on all 48 cases, match full-context correctness, have no full-context-correct-to-reference-wrong row, and preserve disabled tokens when gate off.
evaluation.candidate_decision: Rejected candidate quality remains separately scored; reference acceptance never promotes it.
evaluation.restart_policy: One independent guarded fresh-process restart of the evaluation-only candidate is permitted. It reloads the pinned extension and corrected source-bound image, reproduces seven answers and validates the independently audited source binding.

acceptance.failed_gate: Reject learned candidate and preserve parent; exact-reference acceptance is reported separately.

publication: None. Evaluation-only diagnostic with no checkpoint save, source download or selected-default change.
implementation_overlay: Models the parent-then-candidate admission sequence: candidate images share the independently verified post-parent epoch; restart provenance and all prior integrity fixes are retained.
